caption: The video captures a first-person view from a whitewater kayaker moving through a granite-boulder rapid. A bright pink kayak bow with a Red Bull logo stays at bottom center, pointed into churning white water. The kayaker's left hand grips the paddle shaft high near a pink section, while the right hand holds lower. As the paddle rotates, the black Werner blade sweeps into view above the bow and lowers toward the left side. Spray crosses the lens and the camera tilts upward, enlarging the blue sky and dark overhanging rock. The paddle is carried low and roughly horizontal across the bow, with the right hand near the blade. The kayak translates forward down the chute toward a narrowing gap as droplets and a sun flare accumulate.
relations: As the paddle rotates, the black blade sweeps above the pink bow and lowers toward the left side.
